steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 36
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
I finally got used to waking up early.
Can you take out the trash tonight?

steps.correctTranslation: Eu sempre procrastino nas noites de domingo.

steps.title: Organize a Frase

steps.title: Gramática: Reported Speech
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Reported Speech"?
options: This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
If it rains, I will stay home.
If I were you, I would study more.
He told me he would call later.

steps.title: Idiom: Break the ice
steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: He told a joke to break the ice.
